notes: Draft (Phase 6, lifecycle-lite). gbrain-shootout at frozen master (parameter gbrain_master_sha), common embedder, built as a --gbrain overlay.

cells.lease_basis: 1.15 x estimate $1.23: ingest embeddings about $0.01; query about $0.001 per retrieval (the Phase 4 retrieval-only basis: Voyage rerank and embeddings) x 665: $0.67; reader and judge $0.55 as the vendor cells
cells.command: bun eval/runner/lifecycle-lite.ts --system gbrain-shootout --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_master_sha}}" --seeds 1,2,3,4,5 --policy fixed-evidence --qa reader --restart --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/lifecycle-lite"
cells.setup_command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_master_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_master_sha}}
